author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Molina promoted to Triple-A
desc: The St. Louis Cardinals are promoting LHP Mason Molina to Triple-A Memphis.
impact: Molina posted a 2.87 ERA along with 82 strikeouts in 69 innings for Double-A Springfield.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Brooks promoted to Triple-A
desc: The Colorado Rockies are promoting RHP Jake Brooks to Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Brooks recorded a 4.71 ERA along with 66 strikeouts in 78.1 innings for Double-A Hartford

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryant Betancourt promoted to Triple-A
desc: The Colorado Rockies are promoting C Bryant Betancourt to Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Betancourt posted a .269 batting average with 30 extra-base hits and 44 RBI for Double-A Hartford.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jesus Moreno signs minor league deal with Twins
desc: The Twins signed free agent RHP Jesus Moreno to a minor league contract.
impact: Moreno will add pitching depth in the Twins organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Esteban Mejia placed on Single-A Delmarva Development List
desc: The Orioles placed Esteban Mejia on the Single-A Delmarva Development List.
impact: The move will allow Mejia to work on a specialized throwing program without pitching in games. He will remain in Delmarva.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Silvano Hechavarria promoted to High-A
desc: The Blue Jays promoted Silvano Hechavarria to High-A Vancouver.
impact: Hechavarria works his way up from low-A Dunedin.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Scherzer showing improvement following injection
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said the injection Max Scherzer got "did what it should" to free up his left side more.
impact: "He's encouraged with how he feels physically," Schneider said. Scherzer is expected to require at least a couple of rehab starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connelly Early (elbow) to undergo imaging Wednesday
desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Connelly Early will undergo imaging on Wednesday.
impact: Early was removed from Tuesday's start early after throwing four scoreless innings. "Just felt like something toward the back of his elbow," Tracy said.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Charlie Barnes to be called up Wednesday
desc: Charlie Barnes is expected to be called up from Triple-A on Wednesday.
impact: Barnes will add a fresh arm in the bullpen for the Dodgers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wyatt Mills optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Dodgers optioned Wyatt Mills to Triple-A Oklahoma City.
impact: Mills was called up on Tuesday. Charlie Barnes will be called up for a fresh arm.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Lasko suffers injury Tuesday
desc: Ryan Lasko left Tuesday's game early after being involved in a collision with Devin Taylor in the outfield during Double-A Midland's game against Frisco.
impact: Lasko is expected to spend Tuesday night in a hospital. There should be an update on his status on Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Chapman dealing with abdominal strain
desc: Matt Chapman said he left Tuesday's game with an abdominal strain.
impact: Chapman said that the abdominal strain has been bothering him since April. He'll be further evaluated on Wednesday with a trip to the injured list being possible.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brett Harris traded to Red Sox
desc: The Red Sox are acquiring infielder Brett Harris from the A's for right-hander Ben Hansen.
impact: Harris finds a new opportunity after being designated for assignment by the Athletics. He will likely be stashed in Triple-A by Boston.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alec Gamboa to be called up Wednesday
desc: The Red Sox are expected to call-up Alec Gamboa on Wednesday.
impact: Tommy Kahnle was designated for assignment as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tommy Kahnle designated for assignment
desc: The Red Sox designated RHP Tommy Kahnle for assignment.
impact: Kahnle struggled in his lone inning of work on Tuesday against the Nationals. Alec Gamboa is expected to be called up as the corresponding move.
